name: turbovec
description: Indexes and searches embeddings with 2- to 4-bit TurboQuant compression in a Rust library with Python bindings, for local RAG pipelines that need a small memory footprint.

skills.name: Filtered Search
skills.description: Restricts search() to an id allowlist or slot bitmask inside the kernel, returning up to k results from the allowed set without over-fetching.

skills.name: Incremental Saves
skills.description: Persists only what changed since the last sync(path) call with one fsync, so small appends or removals stay fast on large indexes.

skills.name: Framework Integrations
skills.description: Replaces the in-memory vector stores of LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack and Agno through optional pip extras such as turbovec[langchain].
